statement: You are given an array nums of distinct integers sorted in ascending order, and an integer target.
If target is in nums, return its index. If it is not, return the index at which it would be placed if it were inserted so that the array stays sorted.
Both cases come down to the same thing: the first index whose value is at least target. The search must run in O(log n) time.

examples.explanation: 5 is already in the array, at index 2.
2 is not in the array. It belongs between 1 and 3, so inserting it would put it at index 1.

constraints: nums contains distinct values sorted in ascending order
